scope: Provider-compliant Beijing pay-as-you-go SearchQA pilot. Preserves the Phase 1A dataset split, paired seven-method workload, strict parser, frozen Phase 0N guard, exact attempt accounting, and immutable source contracts while migrating only the model route from qwen3.6-flash Token Plan to qwen3.5-flash PAYG.

pricing_snapshot.source: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio qwen3.5-flash model documentation, Beijing, input <=128K
pricing_snapshot.conversion_policy: CNY is authoritative. USD is a fixed accounting display conversion only.

dataset.name: SearchQA
dataset.seed_semantics: Three deterministic, pairwise-disjoint example replicates; these are not claims of provider sampling randomness.
dataset.selection: Sort unused item IDs by SHA-256(seed:item_id), then take the first items_per_replicate.
dataset.pairing: Every method uses the identical ordered evaluation IDs within a replicate. Guarded methods additionally use the identical ordered probe IDs.

frozen_candidate_source.held_out_seed_warning: Do not tune any threshold or action using Phase 0N seeds 161-180, including adversarial seed 176.

planned_workload.formula: 3 replicates * 112 evaluation items * 7 methods + 3 replicates * 8 probe items * 2 guarded methods * 2 branches

accounting_contract.logical_calls: Count one completed requested model inference, independently of retries.
accounting_contract.provider_attempts: Count and journal every provider request, including failed and orphaned attempts.
accounting_contract.retries: provider_attempts - completed logical_calls while resuming; equals failed attempts after a complete one-success-per-call run.
accounting_contract.failed_attempt_usage: Charge all provider-reported failed-attempt usage. Refuse further paid execution after any request whose usage is unknown.
accounting_contract.fallback_calls: Mark and sum explicit cold-reference or cold-fallback logical calls; never hide them inside a parent call.
accounting_contract.pre_invocation_reservation: Before every request, reserve the full 8192-input plus 512-output per-attempt envelope at frozen PAYG prices.
accounting_contract.currency: CNY is authoritative under an absolute 200.00 cap.

resume_contract.run_id: SHA-256 over config fingerprint, manifest fingerprint, replicate seed, method, stage, branch, and item ID.
resume_contract.attempt_journal: Persist attempts.jsonl before appending the completed call record.
resume_contract.orphan_success: Reconstruct the completed call from the successful terminal journal entry without another provider request.
resume_contract.unknown_usage: Refuse all further paid execution until manually resolved.

predeclared_gates.immutable_inputs: Config, dataset, split manifest, skill, source implementations, runner, and frozen Phase 0N source hashes must match.
predeclared_gates.prompt_parity: Dry-run and live use the same rollout prompt builders and prepared messages.
predeclared_gates.guard_order: All 32 paired guard calls for a replicate complete before any evaluation call in that replicate.
predeclared_gates.guard_behavior: Accept only at round 8 with lower bound >= -0.06; reject harmful evidence under the frozen margin, horizon, and recovery conditions; otherwise abstain to cold.
predeclared_gates.strict_parser: Valid single tags parse; missing, multiple, empty, nested, and unbalanced tags fail explicitly.
predeclared_gates.resume_integrity: Attempt-first journaling supports exact reconstruction without duplicate provider requests.
predeclared_gates.exact_accounting: Every attempt, logical call, cumulative token, and CNY identity must hold.
predeclared_gates.budget_enforcement: The full per-attempt envelope is reserved before invocation and the absolute CNY cap is 200.00.
predeclared_gates.smoke_before_batch: Run exactly one paid logical call and audit usage, cost, parse format, and reasoning content before resuming the remaining workload.
predeclared_gates.promotion_rule: This Phase 1B pilot cannot enable formal 128/512 scaling; formal_scaling_allowed remains false.
